title: Teaching Material Question Bank
description: Per EO-S1.1-001 v1.1, refined by EO-S1.1-002 v1.0. At minimum single_choice/true_false/fill_blank; calculation/essay added only when the source material genuinely supports them. Every question must carry a source trace — never a bare, untraceable question. EO-S1.1-002: every question must also declare origin — 'Original' for a question copied verbatim from the source material (e.g. an actual exam question), 'AI' for a question Claude derived from the material's content (never invented from nothing — still traceable via source).

origin.description: EO-S1.1-002: 'Original' = copied verbatim from the source material; 'AI' = derived by Claude from the material's real content

source.description: Traceability to the real source material — never fabricated
